en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Abdullah and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah, raising it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Abu Talib<sup>as</sup><sup>ws</sup> professed to Al-Islam by the accounting of Al-Jummal (Use of alphabetical letters in accordance to their numerical value)’.
